  {q : Allow.DocumentDraft.Request} {a : Allow.DocumentDraft.Artifact} (response : Allow.DocumentDraft.Bytes)
  (ha : auth) (hr : Allow.DocumentDraft.receipt s k = none) (quota : Allow.DocumentDraft.Admission s q a)
  (policyCurrent : q.policy = s.policy) (reportCurrent : a.report.policy = q.policy) (stale : q.base ≠ s.revision) :
  Allow.DocumentDraft.Step auth s k q a Allow.DocumentDraft.Result.rejected
    { revision := s.revision, history := s.history,
      receipts :=

            outcome := Allow.DocumentDraft.Outcome.denied response } ::
          s.receipts,
      policy := s.policy }
